facts.text: V noci stoupá do mělké vody a krmí se tam.
facts.quote: During the night, however, they rise to much shallower waters (2 to 20 m depth) to feed.

facts.text: Chapadla jsou dlouhá a tenká a mají vroubky pro lepší úchop kořisti.
facts.quote: The tentacles of this species are long and thin, having raised ridges which help provide grip when catching prey.
